title: Lavatories.
officialText:
Where lavatories are provided, at least 5 percent, but not less than one, shall be accessible. Where the total
lavatories provided in a toilet room or bathing room is six or more, at least one lavatory with enhanced reach ranges in accordance with
ICC A117.1, shall be provided.
*1109.2.4 Diaper changing accommodations. In assembly group A occupancies and mercantile group M occupancies on each floor
level containing a public toilet room, both male and female occupants shall have access to at least one safe, sanitary and convenient
diaper changing station, deck, table or similar amenity, which shall comply with Section 603.5 (Diaper Changing Tables) of ICC
A117.1.
*Section 1109.2.4 was added by Local Law 34 of 2018. This law has an effective date of July 8, 2018.
